tasks.instruction: Add the ending to the word in capitals. Sometimes the last letter doubles and sometimes it does not - that is the whole question here, so the spelling has to be exactly right.

items.sentence: The dog kept __________ after the ball until it was too tired to move.
We __________ my grandmother every Sunday until she moved away.
It was only the __________ of the story and already three people had disappeared.
She __________ the door quietly so that nobody would hear her.
They spent the whole afternoon __________ in the lake.
Nobody __________ to a word he said.
